item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.11)] Product Authenticity Is Becoming Platform Infrastructure
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.11)
Cerfinity's new white paper, "The Provenance Layer: Why Commerce Platforms Must Move Beyond the Sale," argues that product-level authenticity is transitioning from a secondary concern to core infrastructure for e-commerce platforms. This shift is driven by increased counterfeiting in the resale market, the upcoming EU Digital Product Passport, and rising consumer demand for verifiable high-value goods. The paper highlights the "Passport Gap" where current authentication methods fail in resale scenarios and proposes tamper-proof authentication tied to a verifiable chain of custody, implemented early in the product lifecycle, as the solution.
